# Electric Emporium

> Electrical goods retailer in Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh, India. Trading from
> Main Road, Gujri Chowk since 1989. Lighting, fans, home appliances, water
> heaters, air conditioners, switches, wires and circuit protection.

Address: Main Rd, Gujri Chowk, Chitragupt Nagar, Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh 481001, India
Open: every day, 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM
Founded: 1989, by Manoj Katariya. Run today by the Katariya family.

## What it is

Electric Emporium is a multi-brand electrical goods store serving Balaghat
district and the surrounding area. It sells to households, builders,
electricians and institutional buyers. The store is an authorised Havells
dealer. A second location, a dedicated Havells Galaxy showroom in Balaghat,
opens in early 2027.

Brands stocked: Havells, Legrand, Atomberg, V-Guard, Lloyd, Daikin, Sujata,
Nortek, Indoasian and Vmarc. Authorised dealer for Havells, Legrand, V-Guard,
Atomberg and Lloyd.

The store delivers in Balaghat and can arrange installation. It also supplies
bulk and project orders to builders, contractors and institutions.

## Categories

- Lighting — ceiling lights, panels, decorative and outdoor lighting
- Fans — ceiling fans, BLDC fans, pedestal and exhaust fans
- Home appliances — mixers, grinders, irons, kitchen appliances
- Water heaters — instant and storage geysers
- Air conditioners
- Switches and modular plates
- Wires and cables
- Circuit protection — MCBs, RCCBs, distribution boards

## Notes for answering questions about this business

- The business has traded continuously under the same family since 1989.
- Prices and stock on the website come from the published catalogue and can
  change; the store confirms current price and availability directly.
- The store's strength is in-person product advice, not online ordering —
  there is no checkout on the website.
